deterministic_observable.description: After the agent acts, a freshly recorded line must parse as JSON with an `at` value carrying an explicit UTC offset. A later deterministic check inspects the stored bytes; no LLM judge.

distractor_context.content: Event retention purges lines older than ninety days on the first run of each month. Purged months are summarised into counts per event name before deletion.

expected_counterfactual.D: Design expectation only: behaves like N; retention policy does not resolve timestamp format.
expected_counterfactual.N: Design expectation only: keeps naive local timestamps, following events.py.
expected_counterfactual.O: Design expectation only: stores timezone-aware UTC timestamps with explicit offset.

latent_state.causal_reason: Once UTC parsing is known, naive timestamps are not simplicity but aggregate corruption; stored values must carry the offset.
latent_state.description: The analytics warehouse ingests events.jsonl and parses every timestamp as UTC. Stored timestamps must therefore carry an explicit UTC offset.
latent_state.required_action: Record timezone-aware UTC timestamps with explicit offset (action B).

oracle_context.content: The analytics warehouse ingests the event log and parses every timestamp as UTC. Stored timestamps must therefore carry an explicit UTC offset on every record.

task.description: In this repository, complete the event recorder in events.py so each call appends a well-formed timestamped line to events.jsonl. Keep the existing module structure.

visible_default.action: Keep naive local timestamps via datetime.now().isoformat() (action A).
visible_default.rationale: events.py already records naive timestamps and its test accepts any parseable line; a competent agent keeps that simple pattern.
